Revised Guidelines of IQAC and submission of AQAR Page 26 6.3.4 Research and Development 1. The college provides financial assistance to teachers for attending/presenting Research papers in Conferences/ Seminars/ workshops. 2. Organise guest lectures 3. Teachers are granted FDP facility to pursue their doctoral degree programme 4. Faculty members apply for minor and major research projects. 5. A UGC Sponsored National Conference was jointly organized by department of English and Geography. 6. National seminar “Sindhyat Ji Jhalak” by the Sindhi department in collaboration with National Council for Promotion of Sindhi Language, New Delhi. 7. A large number of faculty members presented research papers in National and International conferences/seminars. 8. Faculty published research Papers in reputed and Peer Reviewed journals 9. Coordinating research promotion activities through PGRD Committee 10. A booklet containing „Standard Formats‟ of research proposals is prepared 11. Research Proposal Approval Committee for guiding teachers in research funding proposal submission. 12. UG students are encouraged to do research projects at department level. 13. Encourage students to organize and to participate in research based competitions 14. Regular participation of students in International Economic Convention organised by HSNC Board. 6.3.5 Library, ICT and physical infrastructure / instrumentation  Use of e-Granthalaya software  Open book access to students  Regular weeding of books  Departmental Libraries as extension of library facility  Book bank facility for students  Internet facility for teachers and students  Photocopying facility for teachers  College has 08 well equipped computer laboratories  ICT enabled offices, Examination Department and IQAC  Internet connections in offices, IQAC, Library ,CS/IT LABS and PG Departments

Revised Guidelines of IQAC and submission of AQAR Page 25  Teachers attending the Syllabus related programmes, communicate the Curriculum Developments to other teachers in the Department  Teachers develop and provide course material for the students  Certificate courses like Spanish, BEC, General Semantic to develop the language, communication and thinking skills  Facilitate faculty to avail FDP for pursing Ph.D. Programme  Academic programmes are conducted through various forums 6.3.2 Teaching and Learning 1. The educational, industrial and field visits are held for the students 2. Screening of films and documentaries for the students 3. Research based assignments and presentation by students. 4. Wall paper activity by students 5. Use of Google groups and Social Networking Sites as communication channels 6. Arranging guest lectures by experts and alumni, in various subjects 7. Use of ICT for students from FY to PG 8. Participation of teachers in the faculty development programmes 9. Remedial lectures and subject related quiz competitions 10. Orientation sessions for new entrants about Library, Examination, College Forums, etc. 11. Guest lectures 12. Group discussions 6.3.3 Examination and Evaluation 1. Online test, class tests, assignments and preliminary examinations are regular features in the college 2. Ensures the smooth and fair conduct of exams 3. Processing of the results using computer software (SARAL) for declaration of results in stipulated time frame 4. Moderation and revaluation is done as per UOM norms 5. Unfair means committee handles cases of unfair means as per UOM guidelines

Revised Guidelines of IQAC and submission of AQAR Page 27 6.3.6 Human Resource Management  Distribution of administrative responsibilities through Principal, Vice Principals, Head of Departments and Chairpersons of various committees  Walk in channel of communication is followed  Compensatory leave to staff for working on holidays as per rule  Faculty members are encouraged to attend Orientation/Refresher programmes  Courses for career advancement  Induction program for newly recruited staff members  Welfare schemes for teaching and non-teaching staff  Monetary incentives to non-teaching staff for putting in extra hours of work 6.3.7 Faculty and Staff recruitment  Non-teaching staff recruitment as per Govt. rules  Faculty recruitment as per UOM and UGC guidelines 6.3.8 Industry Interaction / Collaboration 1. College has an MOU with MPCB. The college has 6 Sampling units and regular results of the monitoring is done by the students under the „earn and learn‟ scheme and sent to MPCB. 2. College has an MOU with Balwant Parikh Research Centre, Baroda for organizing Course on General Semantics. 3. College has Business English Certificate course (BEC) in collaboration with Cambridge English Language Assessment–Part of the University of Cambridge 4. College has tie-up with Scientists from Haffkine Institute and University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad as Co-Investigators in the Major Research Project. 5. For job placements students were sent to TCS, Infosys, L&T InfoTech , IGate, Capgemini and Accenture. 6. Various departments conducted industrial visits 6.3.9 Admission of Students  Admissions are granted as per Govt. and UOM norms  Admission committees are made for each faculty  Proper timetable for admission is made, displayed and followed
